ModMetaData.name: Ra2Bunker Endpoint LOS Fix V5.2
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5.4063 LOS fix for Ra2Bunker. V5.2 keeps the original 0.75 fill and makes Ra2_Bunker opaque by default. The patch now scopes exemptions at the actual cell-visibility layer: GenSight.LineOfSight, ShootLeanUtility.CellCanSeeCell and LeanShootingSourcesFromTo. Only a bunker physically occupying the current source or destination cell is transparent for that one LOS calculation. Empty or occupied bunkers continue to block outside-to-outside sight and fire.
